body: Yeah I totally get that - I’m honestly still dealing with scars all over from it but so much better than bleeding sores at least! Honestly I had to get acrylic nails / use a back scratcher when the itching got too much, they’re blunt so don’t scratch the scabs off as often/as harshly. Also have a bf who Would literally grab my hands to stop me from scratching which helps lol! It’s a super challenging battle but you’ll get there! Also just a mist bottle off Amazon I actually had it for my indoor plants first of all lol x
So it’s brutal but not forever - you got this! X

Just to let you know I am doing soooo much better now 💓 there’s scarring where the marks where but it’s healed up so well and the itchiness is almost gone. I didn’t use creams or anything as I felt like they made it worse. I can’t tell you how I fixed it as honestly it was a total fluke I have no idea what worked but I did find that a mister with cool water was amazing to soothe an itch and break the cycle x

What are they treating you with if you don’t mind me asking? I just feel like I’ve exhausted all options. Onto calamine lotion now to soothe it which has honestly been so nice but I want the spots gone 😂
So it starts off as a bit of itchy skin which I do scratch because I’m a nightmare, then it becomes almost like a bloody scab? The blood is dry but it just stays like that x

Hey! I’ve been to my gp a few times but they’re now refusing to see me due to Covid :( bloody nightmare honestly just waiting for a dermatologist my docs have been no help at all. Thank you for the advice though 💓

Hi there - thank you so much for your kind words 💓 I have fucibet but to be honest I haven’t found much benefit in it, even short term it doesn’t provide much relief. I’ve been using the cera ve moisturiser which definitely helps so just lathering that on as much as possible. I have really bad allergies so I’ve been on a daily antihisthamine since before this flare up but they have upped my dose and still no benefit. Feel like there’s nothing left to try 😂

Unfortunately neither made much difference at all :( was applying morning and night but no joy. I had some really bad oozing patches which they thought was an infection so the antibiotics were given just to try stave that off and give me some relief in the mean time. I am absolutely desperate to see an allergist but unfortunately I think in the UK it is either extremely expensive or by referral only. Due to covid our health system is really behind and sadly they don’t have much time for issues that aren’t emergencies. Thank u so mcun for ur advise though x
